svg.title: Proposed production architecture — ADR 001
svg.text: C4 system context and container view · design proposal; none of these containers exist yet

g.text: Sets up tenant users and CRM
Database-backed job queue; no separate queue service is assumed in this proposal.
Retries are bounded; failed jobs remain recoverable. CRM export is idempotent.
Human review and approval happen before CRM export.
Retention and deletion policy covers audio, transcripts, drafts, logs where applicable, and backups.
Offline audio is stored on the device until upload succeeds, then deleted in line with the retention policy.
Design change: The production proposal uses separate transcription and extraction stages. The demo uses one
multimodal audio call. This is an intentional design change whose latency, cost, and quality trade-offs should be
Open question: These diagrams assume the rep dictates their own voice note after the visit, as the demo does.
Confirm with product: if the rep instead records the customer conversation, add the customer as a participant and
a recording notice and consent step.
